description.value: Caffè Artigiano is a pioneering Vancouver-born specialty coffee chain with over 25 years of history, known for award-winning latte art, 100% ethically sourced Arabica beans roasted locally in Burnaby, and artisanal in-house baked goods. The Richmond location sits within the McArthur Glen Outlet Mall. In recent years the brand has expanded into Cafe-Bar concepts serving cocktails, sourdough pizzas, and light Italian bites alongside its core coffee program.

address.value: Unit 82, McArthur Glen Outlet Mall, Richmond, BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Artigiano is a real, actively operating specialty coffee chain with 25+ locations across BC and Alberta; the Richmond location is listed under 'McArthur Glen Outlet Mall.'
